about_the_game:
Move, catch and survive as you can!

In the endless void of space, survival depends on what you can salvage. Face endless waves of relentless hostile fleets using only your piloting skills and the scraps you can collect. Fly through the battlefield, gathering modules that stack and enhance your ship’s offensive and defensive systems. With every piece of scrap, your spaceship grows stronger, if you can stay alive long enough to collect it. No aiming, no firing, your ship fights automatically, leaving you free to focus on movement, dodging, and making the right pickups.

How long can you endure in this relentless battle for survival?

Features

  • Genre: Horde survivor.

  • Theme: Sci-fi. Clean, atmospheric space visuals with a modern arcade feel.

  • View: Top-down / 2.5D

  • Endless Survival: Face relentless waves of hostile fleets in the infinite void of space.

  • Dynamic Upgrades (In-game): Collect floating modules to enhance your ship’s offensive and defensive systems in real time.

  • Module Limits Rewards: Surpass module caps to auto-repair your hull, or convert pickups into currency when at full health.

  • Single-Player Focus: Designed for pure survival challenge and replayability.
